entry.title: Edifício Copan
entry.note: Fresh raw Q632566 way 8100248 independently matches the preserved 200-point ground ring within 0.002 m rounding. Anchor [-46.644483918,-23.546584452] and heading 0.390775195386 remain fixed; native +X points ENE at 67.61 degrees and +Z SSE at 157.61 degrees. The municipal restoration record independently calls the perforated cobogo facade the south facade. Raw coordinates place rear lift and stair projections on that side, opposite the principal northern brise curve (outline indices 0–64). The conservation plan and contractor photographs confirm the separate glazed rear block, screened rear blocks, one capsule lift tower and three open stair projections. Named southwest/northwest ends in the redrawn conservation plan are not used as compass controls: their reproduced page compass has not been reconciled with the raw site. Base Y0 is approximate local grade; actual street slope remains unsurveyed. Retain 115 m and 32 residential floors from the published IBGE record as the reconstruction basis; mapped 118.44 m and 37 total levels remain separately reported, without a surveyed datum reconciliation. No footprint replacement. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
